# Roushan Kumar - UX/UI and Product Designer

> Official portfolio of Roushan Kumar, a UX/UI and Product Designer based in Ahmedabad, India. Focus areas: SaaS, B2B, fintech, enterprise workflows, and mobile experiences.

Roushan works end-to-end, from understanding user problems through research and information architecture to interaction design, production-ready designs, and design systems.

## Primary sources

- [Full text portfolio and profile](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/portfolio.md): authoritative profile, contact details, and selected project descriptions.
- [Portfolio home page](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/): visual portfolio and project overview.
- [About section](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#about)

## Selected projects

- [Roushani - mobile-first B2B invoicing SaaS](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#case-study-roushani): Production MVP delivered in four weeks; product strategy, research, invoicing flows, customer and service reuse, branding, and PDF export.
- [Umbrella - enterprise third-party onboarding](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#case-study-umbrella): NDA onboarding redesign informed by five usability sessions; clearer structure, validation, visual hierarchy, and user flow.
- [Bridge2Business - B2B website redesign](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#case-study-bridge2business): Freelance design concept focused on information architecture, responsive design, and communicating services. Not developed or launched.
- [Maxlence - HR and project management SaaS](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#case-study-maxlence): End-to-end UX for onboarding, role-aware workflows, project tracking, attendance, and customizable dashboards.
- [Naie - hyperlocal salon appointment and discovery platform](https://portfolio26sep26.vercel.app/#case-study-naie): Validated prototype for customer discovery and booking with salon-side operations, appointment availability, queue transparency, and staff selection.
